The existing accepted-send path reads the canonical scoped list key before invalidating Draft or first-send-refusal state. This does not alter send admission, outbox persistence, resend identity, attachment custody, preferences writes, command/experience completion or provider acceptance. The SDK reference owns refresh/deadline prose; related documents retain their existing scope and failure limits. Real scoped cache, transport race, mounted provider and send-acceptance tests exercise the changed seams; no native/hosted qualification is inferred.
